g.text: PR #2388 · Honest composer effort controls
The effort picker appeared for drivers that ignored its value.
Only Codex now exposes and forwards composer effort overrides.
BEFORE
AFTER
render_reasoning_effort_select
Every agent shows Auto through XHigh.
Claude, Muse and Antigravity ignore the override.
Saved reasoning_effort
A session preference survives between visits.
Hiding only the picker would still send its value.
Text, uploads and secret drops
All submission paths forward the saved selection.
The UI suggests a setting changed when it did not.
InputBarProps.agent_type
The session supplies the actual agent type.
The picker renders only for Codex.
supported_reasoning_effort
Codex retains its chosen override or Auto.
Unsupported drivers receive None.
effective_reasoning_effort
Text, uploads and secret drops share the guard.
Hidden persisted preferences cannot leak to sends.
Claude live effort, resolved effort display and ultrathink capability remain follow-up integration work.
